No checksums are marked as 'SKIP', so all sources are verified. There is no evidence of malicious behavior, such as downloading content during build time, executing remote code, or exfiltrating data.

The metadata aligns with standard AUR packaging practices for a `-bin` package. The sources are from the project's official GitHub release page, and the checksums ensure the integrity of the distributed binaries. No dangerous or suspicious operations are indicated in this file, and it does not contain executable code or commands. As such, this file presents no security risk.
</details>
